JBIG2 build headers carry Chromium copyright notices (2012 and 2015). The supplement retains the first three lines of build_config.h verbatim plus the complete Chromium BSD license from pinned revision f71e47fc0edf5b2bae628835c5d9def62169b65d. This is notice delivery, not an exact upstream revision mapping for build_config.h. Exact build_config.h bytes also match Chromium 444cda9b1f3be33fffb7c6f93e50d33d4bd39635; its LICENSE is identical to the retained text. Emscripten 6.0.9/6.0.10 top-level and system-library notices are also retained, including optional components; this is not a claim that every listed library is linked into a decoder. Rust 1.97.1 source-component notices (including optional targets) and QCMS reproduction dependency notices are also retained; crate notice bytes were checked against vendored package checksums and the pinned lockfile.
